description: Source code for the Emergency Access Daemon (ead), implementing network packet handling, authentication, and server management using pcap and custom protocols.

classes.name: ead_instance
classes.description: Represents an instance of the ead server with network interface info and process ID.

methods.name: ead_open_pcap
methods.description: Creates and configures a pcap handle for capturing packets on a specified interface.

methods.name: prepare_password
methods.description: Prepares user password and cryptographic parameters for authentication.

methods.name: set_recv_type
methods.description: Configures the receive type for a pcap handle on Linux.

methods.name: handle_packet
methods.description: Processes incoming network packets and triggers message parsing.

methods.name: parse_message
methods.description: Parses and handles different message types received in packets.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts a server instance for a given ead_instance, handling packet capture and processing.
